mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_ai_preference ( user_id, prefer_subject, prefer_question_types, prefer_difficulty, prefer_options_count, prefer_with_analysis, common_knowledge_points, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{preferSubject}, #{preferQuestionTypes}, #{preferDifficulty}, #{preferOptionsCount}, #{preferWithAnalysis}, #{commonKnowledgePoints}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_ai_preference SET prefer_subject = #{preferSubject}, prefer_question_types = #{preferQuestionTypes}, prefer_difficulty = #{preferDifficulty}, prefer_options_count = #{preferOptionsCount}, prefer_with_analysis = #{preferWithAnalysis}, common_knowledge_points = #{commonKnowledgePoints}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
